titre: Black castles. What does White play? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Sicilian Marshall Gambit: Black castles with no knight on f6 to guard h7. The Greek gift: Bxh7+, Ng5+, Qh5 threatening mate; after the queen checks, the other knight checks and Bg5+ skewers the king and the black queen. Black's best was 8…Bd7. Seen in 4 real Lichess games (puzzle rated ~1490). Would you have sacrificed the bishop? 👇
